title.narrative: Strengthen DOTS Strategy within the Framework of the New Strategy: Stop TB - Guatemala (01-Jul-2022-30-Jun-2025)

description.narrative: Guatemala, Tuberculosis, Ministry of Health and Social Assistance of the Republic of Guatemala (MSPAS)This program has the following goals: Reducir la prevalencia, incidencia y mortalidad por tuberculosis en todas sus formas en el país.// Reduce the prevalence, incidence and mortality of all forms of tuberculosis in the country.. The objectives of this program are: Fortalecer la detección y diagnóstico precoz de la TB y TB-FR, sobretodo en grupos de alto riesgo por medio de uso de pruebas moleculares y otros medios de diagnostico rapidos. //Strengthen the early detection and diagnosis of TB and DR-TB, especially in high-risk groups through the use of molecular tests and other means of rapid diagnosis.. Mejorar el éxito de tratamiento de las personas con TB y TB-FR, con el soporte centrado en el paciente. // Improve treatment success for people with TB and DR-TB, with patient-centered support. Disminuir la carga de tuberculosis entre personas que viven con VIH y de VIH en afectados con tuberculosis.// Reduce the burden of tuberculosis among people living with HIV and HIV among those affected with tuberculosis. Mejorar el cumplimiento de las actividades preventivas contra la TB. // Improve compliance of TB prevention activities

title.narrative: Impact indicators targets and results for GTM-T-MSPASP03
RR-TB and/or MDR-TB prevalence among new TB patients: Proportion of new TB patients with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB
Outcome indicators targets and results for GTM-T-MSPASP03

TB treatment coverage: Percentage of patients with new and relapse TB that were notified and treated among the estimated number of incident TB in the same year (all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for GTM-T-MSPASP03
Number of TB cases (all forms) notified among prisoners
Number of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment
Number of people in contact with TB patients who began preventive therapy

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of TB cases, all forms, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB cases registered for treatment during a specified period, new and relapse cases
Number of TB cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Number of notified cases of all forms of TB (i.e. bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed), new and relapse cases
